name: Broken wall
description: Collapsed segments of the stone wall, same thickness and line as the wall kit, with breaches and fallen blocks. Concept for review (#149): map decoration, random starting ruins, or what demolition (#130) or a battle leaves behind. No game mechanics yet.

variants.name: Breach
variants.notes: Full-height wall broken through in the middle.

variants.name: Crumbling wall
variants.notes: Uneven top, a little damage, a few loose blocks.

variants.name: Overgrown wall
variants.notes: Low broken wall with grass and moss.
